git_authorization.after08_only: organize, commit and push research on this development branch

route: Direct terminal-win evolutionary search over bounded conditional decision programs, not a hidden-world predictor or wolf-probability fitting

program.representation: one predicate and two selector leaves per phase,15small integers; role-specific blocks may be optimized independently because k1roles never share actions
program.invariants: Legality, own knownwolf/clear facts, authenticated dead-seer results, unread checks, original doomed-ally bus and seer-priority night remain protected. No opponent labels/evaluator seeds/actual hidden worlds are policy inputs.

training.selection: scan deterministic deals until quotas satisfied before reading outcomes; skipped indices retained
training.initialization: B0 and simpleselector programs plus random conditional programs, not only single-step B0 perturbations
training.mutation: fixed random generator keyed byresearch-only seed; change predicate/selector/crossover role-block; no actor access to thisseed
training.fitness: paired role-win delta minus0.25times mean negative background delta; no protocol errors allowed; ties favor fewer nonbase leaves
training.cache: only evaluator caches identical(role-specific program,scenario)games; tested that other-role genes cannot affect a k1game

selection.procedure: evaluate fixed trainingelites and B0 once; choose highest fixed fitness only if pooled role delta>0, otherwise B0 role; do not mutate after reading502

development_replication.compare: one frozen combined program against B0 with same seat/deal, strict/rt
development_replication.boundary: population8is optimizer-family holdout, but was observed in prior research; do not call it a wholly new independent implementation

confirmation.use_only_if: stabledevelopment gain and no concerning slices
confirmation.gates: unchanged2pp overall, conservative paired lower>0, role/background checks and zero protocol/internal failures
confirmation.no_candidate: retain B0; continue adversarial diagnostics/guard tests until08 rather than repeatedly consuming heldouts

logging: ARENA_RECORD/STATE/SUMMARY=0; compressed synthetic evaluation records and compact train logs; input/source/model hashes; all failed candidates retained
limits: Best empirical candidate in this finite program/opponent class is not a proof of globally optimal Werewolf strategy. Development populations and repeated batches are not independent evidence. No changes to tournament entry.
